name: musl
purpose: Restore libc functions removed from Zig's musl tree and reimplemented in lib/c/*.zig or compiler_rt/*.zig, without invoking Zig.
selection: Files in upstream src/, arch/, include/ absent at the same relative path in pinned Zig lib/libc/musl, plus full original include/, src/include/ and src/internal/ to restore declarations removed by Zig. Original contents and COPYRIGHT copied to vendor/musl. malloc/oldmalloc sources are not compiled.
validation: src/stdio/vfprintf.c, src/internal/libc.h and src/thread/pthread_create.c compare byte-identical with pinned Zig's vendored source.
